title: <project> status register
summary: Execution state and pointers for <project> under the Zafir development process. Schema: REGISTER-SCHEMA.md of zafir-development-process.

rules.text: Unique ids.
Every dependency exists and is not the row itself.
No dependency cycle.
States belong to the declared enums.
Qualifiers encode no extra state.
implementable=true satisfies every implementation gate.
done implies implementable=false.
done implies verification.state=passed.
done has at least one immutable revision and the required test evidence.
blocked names a concrete blocker in qualifier, reason or next action.
won't-do records the decision or successor.
Every negative readiness has a reason.
Components and contexts use declared vocabularies.
Dates are valid ISO-8601.
Notes reference existing ids.
A state-changing commit updates the register atomically with the change it reports.

Table order is the decided default priority. Without concurrency a slice starts only as its feature's next unfinished slice; with parallelAllowed, admission follows CONCURRENCY.md. Concurrent execution implies no predecessor or join edge. Each slice waits only for its own dependencies, authoritatively done. Removing an edge needs evidence and an approved plan revision.
At most one feature row has architecture.state = pending-change.

done requires base, verification passed, a recorded review, and every earlier phase commit, found by trailer (Z7). A slice is authoritatively done only with its integration commit and combined-tree evidence; a branch's done releases nothing.
A security placeholder still active at feature closure is in kept with a decision covering deployable builds, possible only for builds holding test data.
A feature is done only when its slices are done or won't-do and none of its placeholders is active without a kept decision.
parallelAllowed: true requires recorded user authorization and nonempty, unique, normalized plannedFiles without globs. Overlapping envelopes do not block admission; CONCURRENCY.md's serial rules do.

Slice commits carry the trailers Slice: <id> and Phase: 1|2|3|integration; evidence.commits holds base, and Z3 finds the other phase commits with git log --grep "^Slice: <id>$". No SHA is appended after the fact.

columns.name: id
columns.label: Id
columns.description: <feature-slug> for features, <feature-slug>-NN for slices and investigations.

columns.name: dependsOn
columns.label: Depends on
columns.description: Real dependencies only, never the owning feature row.

columns.name: components
columns.label: Components
columns.description: Module map plus api, ui, database, tests, docs; declared at the first Step 4.

columns.name: contexts
columns.label: Contexts
columns.description: Bounded contexts from CONTEXT-MAP.md, or the single project context.

columns.name: assessments
columns.label: Assessments
columns.description: Map name -> {state, references, qualifier}; governingContext is required.

columns.name: parallelAllowed
columns.label: Parallel allowed
columns.description: Recorded permission for concurrent admission (Z6); required on slices and investigations, default false.

columns.name: plannedFiles
columns.label: Planned files
columns.description: Envelope forecast of repository-relative paths, [] when unknown; required on slices and investigations.

columns.name: placeholders
columns.label: Placeholders
columns.description: {reuses: [name], introduces: [{name, standsInFor, livesAt, security, replacedBy}], replaces: [name], kept: [{name, decision}]}.
